title: Exotic Velvety Brazilian Sevaiiya Noodles
description: A resinous and velvety Brazilian dish featuring sevaiiya, this romantic meal is perfect for a night in, and is macrobiotic-friendly and cooked to perfection in a wok.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large wok over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the sevaiiya noodles to the wok and stir to combine with the onion and mushroom mixture.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brazilian spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the noodles and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Remove the wok from the heat and garnish with chopped scallions.
